context: Found while starting batch 4, in this project's own earlier step-3 work (batches 1-3). Two defects, both mine, both in how label caveats were handled.
defect_1_caveats_never_reached_the_event: Every step-3 signoff record (reports/m2-step3-batch1-signoff-2026-10-02.json, ...batch2..., ...batch3...) says the proposed label caveats 'travel with the computed labels'. Step 2 honored that by writing a 'caveats' array into each affected event in config/m2-step2-events.json (4 of its 45 events). Step 3 did not: all 30 events built across batches 1-3 carried zero caveats, so the caveats existed only in the signoff packets. Caveats do not affect any computed label or labels_sha256 (the digest covers label values/reasons only), so no result was ever wrong -- but the metadata the owner approved was missing from the data.
defect_2_packet_caveats_named_labels_tha: Three proposed_label_caveat lists in the signoff packets named labels nre/dataset.py never computes -- the same class of error step 2 already found and corrected for its HURN caveat (commit 8daed6f) and that this project's memory already recorded as a rule (only day1_open/high/low/close_return and session_2/5/10/20_close_return are valid; never build a list from a numeric range). The rule was written down and I did not apply it. Affected packets: reports/m2-step3-batch1-signoff-packet-2026-10-02.json (parr-step3-2024-11-04 listed session_6..session_20; nbix-step3-2025-05-05 listed session_12..session_20) and reports/m2-step3-batch3-signoff-packet-2026-10-02.json (aspn-step3-2025-02-12 listed session_15 and session_20). Two session positions were also miscounted in prose: nbix's 2025-05-22 filing is session 13 (packet said 12); caci-step3-2025-04-23's 2025-05-20 filing is session 19 (packet said it lands on session 20). The packets are left exactly as the owner reviewed them; this record is the correction.

what_changed.events_file: config/m2-step3-events.json: 'caveats' arrays added to 11 events, using only real label names, with each inside-window item's session position computed from the real corrected calendar (nre.event_acquire.event_window), not counted by hand. Rule used (same as step 2's own caveats): an item on session k lists the session-milestone labels at or after k (day1_* are listed only when k == 1, i.e. the item lands on the reaction session itself); 'freshness' caveats for REAL x2 and ASPN list all 8 return labels.
what_changed.validator: nre/event_acquire.py: new LABEL_NAMES constant (the engine's real 16 label names) and a check in _validate_event that every caveat label is one of them or the M1 sentinel 'all' (used by M1's accepted SLSN/LNSR events). tests/test_event_acquire.py: a test that a fabricated name is rejected, a test that LABEL_NAMES equals what the pipeline actually computes for a MAPPED event (so the constant cannot silently drift from the engine), and a test that every caveat in all four shipped events files uses only real names. All four shipped events files (M1, step 2, combined, step 3) validate under the new check; full suite green.

corrected_caveats.item: 2024-11-19 Item 5.05 (the filing batch 2's own packet missed, reports/m2-step3-batch2-competing-catalyst-correction-2026-10-02.json)

effect_on_results: None. No computed label, label_reasons, or labels_sha256 changed or could change: caveats are metadata outside the digest. The 30 pinned results are re-checked by the same push's real workflow run.
not_a_claim: Not a new owner signoff: the owner's three batch signoffs accepted these caveats as informational ('travel with the computed labels'); this implements that, with corrected label names. If the owner would rather these caveats not be carried, the 11 'caveats' arrays are the only thing to remove.
